help_temp:
🌡️ TEMPERATURE
(temperature, 0.0 - 1.0)

Controls translation strictness
and predictability.

• Lower (0.0 - 0.2):
Translation is highly accurate,
strict and literal.
Ideal for UI, code and docs.

• Higher (0.7 - 1.0):
Model generates creative
synonyms and literary turns,
but may alter nuances.
help_topp:
🎯 WORD SAMPLING
(top_p, 0.0 - 1.0)

Restricts token candidate pool.

• Lower (0.1 - 0.3):
Filters out unlikely tokens,
keeping strictly relevant terms.

• Higher (0.8 - 1.0):
Allows rare words and diversity.

Recommended: 0.2
help_tokens:
📏 RESPONSE BUFFER
(max_tokens, 512 - 8192)

Maximum response length
returned by model.

• 1 token ≈ 3-4 chars.

• 2048 - 4096 tokens:
Guarantees full paragraphs,
dialogues or books translate
without mid-sentence cuts.
help_thinking:
🧠 REASONING (CoT)
(Chain of Thought)

Internal reflection process
prior to translation.

❌ OFF (Recommended):
• Instant translation (1-2s).
• Not needed for gaming/prose.

✅ ON:
• Helps with complex logic
riddles and cryptograms.
• Latency rises 10-20x (20-30s).
help_glossary:
📚 SMART GLOSSARY

Contextual terminology injection.

• Hints are injected inline
next to matched source terms.

• Neural model autonomously
inflects case, gender, tense,
and number for natural syntax.

• Eliminates rigid string replacement.
wizard_icon_box_text:
The Hub will generate all files and register the service automatically!

You can add custom icons anytime:
• For the Hub: place Service.png into data/services/<id>/
• For QTranslate: place Service.ico into Services/<Name>/

* If omitted, a default 🤖 icon is used in the Hub and text in QTranslate.
wizard_warn_fill: Please fill in all required fields!
wizard_help_provider:
🏢 API PROVIDER

Select the platform hosting the model:

• Cloudflare Workers AI:
Cloudflare models (ID starts with @cf/...).

• OrcaRouter:
Free model pool (DeepSeek, Qwen, Tencent, Gemma, etc.).
wizard_help_name:
🏷️ SERVICE NAME

Human-readable display name.

• Enter any convenient name (e.g. 'Gemma 4 26B', 'My Fast GPT', 'Game Translator').

• Displayed on the QTranslate button and Hub card header.
wizard_help_id:
📁 FOLDER / SERVICE ID

Unique alphanumeric code name.

• Auto-generated from service name.

• Used as folder name and internal system route.

* Manual edit optional.
wizard_help_model:
🤖 MODEL IDENTIFIER (Model ID)

Exact API model address.

DIFFERENCE:
• Name: display text ('Gemma 4').
• ID: cloud path ('@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it').

WHERE TO COPY:
1. Cloudflare Workers AI: developers.cloudflare.com/ai/models/ -> copy Model ID.
2. OrcaRouter: orcarouter.ai/models -> copy model identifier.

* Copy accurately without spaces!
wizard_help_qtid:
🔢 UNIQUE QTRANSLATE ID

System button ID in QTranslate.

• The Hub scans all scripts in Services/ and allocates the next free number (e.g. 701, 702).

* IDs must be unique to avoid collisions!
